title: Text-Interpretation-Application Lab
purpose: Practise separating observation, interpretation, and application.
body_markdown:
# Text-Interpretation-Application Lab

Use 2 Timothy 2:14-15 and 3:14-17.

## Column 1 - Text observation
What words, commands, contrasts, and purposes appear?

## Column 2 - Interpretation
What do these statements mean in Paul's charge to Timothy?

## Column 3 - Application
What responsible reading practice follows for us?

## Final audit

Label each statement:

1. “Do your best to present yourself to God as one approved.”
2. Christians should never study with other people.
3. Teachers should avoid quarrels that ruin hearers.
4. A careful reader should distinguish a verse from an inherited slogan.

Teacher key: 1 text; 2 unsupported; 3 text; 4 responsible synthesis/application.
